description: Runs a shell command line in one of the allowed folders, e.g. cwd core_dump
Common Linux commands are available: ls, cat, head, tail, grep, find, sed, awk,
sort, wc, diff, tree, du, make, ninja, gcc, git, objdump and more;
run the command help to list them all and see the folders and their access.
No redirection (> <) or $(...). Only curl and wget reach the network.
To add compiler flags and keep the Makefile's own, set them before make:
CPPFLAGS='-DNAME=1' CFLAGS='-Wno-unused-parameter' make (make CFLAGS=... would replace them).
For the date and time: date, or TZ=Asia/Tokyo date for another time zone.

params.name: cwd
params.description: Folder to run in, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump or core_dump/src; omit it when the command does not depend on a folder (whoami, date, uname, bc)

params.name: command
params.description: The command line, e.g. ls -la, cat -n src/main.c, git log --oneline -5; help lists the commands
